title: eSource for clinical trials: implementation and evaluation of a standards-based approach in a real world trial.
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical implementation and clinical evaluation of a data collection system (TRANSFoRm) for clinical trials. While it mentions obtaining ethical approvals and adhering to Good Clinical Practice (GCP), these are standard procedural requirements for medical research and do not constitute an evaluation of religion, faith, or moral/ethical frameworks.
